title: Three-Body Problem as Chinese soft disclosure

tellings.quote: but they've allowed this sci fi series to be published by this Chinese author, that's like pretty trippy.

plain: The Three-Body Problem, a science fiction series about contact with aliens by a Chinese author, is said to be a quiet way for China to prepare people for the truth about aliens. David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who spoke out about UFOs, offers the idea, noting that China "allowed this sci fi series to be published," which he calls "pretty trippy." If true, it would mean a government is using fiction to hint at what it knows.
